issue_request: FHIR-14293 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 BR&R change request asking to correct the ResearchSubject.identifier short description and definition so they refer to the research subject, and to add that the subject id is for a study.
initial_application: The issue was applied in commit f09300abf4272bd789b4f6fd15f5fed283c7d38e on 2017-12-08. That commit explicitly included #14293 in its subject and changed source/researchsubject/researchsubject-spreadsheet.xml from study-oriented identifier wording to 'Business Identifier for research subject in a study' and 'Identifiers assigned to this research subject for a study.' Later source-format migrations preserved the wording in structuredefinition-ResearchSubject.xml.
additional_context: ResearchSubject is active in source/fhir.ini and is listed as approved. The current StructureDefinition source and ResearchSubject-identifier search-parameter bundle both use the corrected subject-in-a-study wording. Zulip and Confluence searches found no issue-specific discussion, refs, or conflicting context.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build-scope source already satisfies the published Jira request.
